subject.title: Bug: Isolated cron job delivery.mode=announce fails with 'Channel openclaw-weixin does not support action send'

question: Should this issue stay in maintainer/live-repro review until a current-main WeChat cron run or focused regression proves whether the message-tool failure still prevents direct outbound fallback?
rationale: Source proves the stable failure mode and current main has both a direct outbound fallback and an enabled message-tool path, but without live/plugin-specific proof automation cannot safely distinguish already-fixed behavior from a remaining fallback bug.

options.title: Keep for live proof
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a current-main WeChat cron run or a focused regression that shows whether message.action failure suppresses direct outbound fallback.

options.title: Queue a generic fix now
options.body: Start a repair PR from source evidence alone, accepting some risk that it patches a path already covered by current main.

options.title: Close as current-main fixed
options.body: Close based on the visible direct send path, accepting that the remaining message-tool path was not proven harmless.

recommendation.title: Keep for live proof
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for a current-main WeChat cron run or a focused regression that shows whether message.action failure suppresses direct outbound fallback.
